entities.name: TatA Q6N5X1
observations: Exact sequence match to the 78-residue query; reviewed UniProt protein from Rhodopseudomonas palustris.
TatA is a component of the twin-arginine translocation system and may form part of the protein-conducting channel.
Localized to the bacterial cell inner membrane as a single-pass membrane protein.
The Tat system transports folded proteins bearing twin-arginine signal peptides.
Sequence contains a TatA_B_E Pfam domain, PF02416.22, spanning positions 4–47.

entities.name: Twin-arginine translocation
observations: TatA participates in protein transport by the Tat complex, including transport of large folded proteins across the bacterial inner membrane.
